enforced_by: the video teardown's doctrine read and the AI brief's frames; recorded as unknown, never refused
note: One list per visual dimension — shot, angle, camera, composition, light, colour, capture (the owner, 2026-10-13); the asset is the dimension.

rows.name: handheld-selfie
rows.what: Front camera, held at arm's length; small natural shake.

extra.real: Micro-shake, the frame drifting with the breath, a re-frame now and then.

rows.name: handheld-rear
rows.what: Rear camera held by someone, or by the subject over an action.

extra.real: Shake, a quick re-focus, auto-exposure catching up.

rows.name: propped
rows.what: Phone leaned on something; the frame does not move.

extra.real: Slightly crooked horizon, the subject a little off-centre.
Level and still, the only movement inside the frame.

rows.name: walk-and-talk
rows.what: The camera moves with a walking subject.

extra.real: Footstep bounce, the background passing, wind noise.

rows.name: push-in
rows.what: The frame moves closer during the shot.

extra.real: Done by a hand on a phone: uneven speed, a small overshoot.
